segments.text: Present the whole program as a set of cooperating boxes, then break the task down so each function owns one smaller job.
Use a concrete function example with inputs and an output. Ask what callers need to know and what details can remain hidden.
Write a formal function specification after the example: state assumptions about inputs and guarantees about the returned value.
Contrast print with return by running two nearly identical functions and checking which value the caller can reuse.
Show a scope error where a local variable is used outside the function. Ask why the name is unavailable and correct the design.
Give a decomposition exercise, review the proposed interfaces, provide feedback, and revise the functions once more.
